Orange County Sheriff-Coroner Department — Policy 610.

§ 610.1 Purpose and Scope.
This policy provides guidance for the authorized uses of the cellular site simulator technology by the Orange County Sheriff's Department, consistent with Government Code section 53166.

§ 610.7 Reporting Requirements.
The program coordinator shall provide an internal annual report to the Sheriff covering use of the technology.
